policy.cash_actions: Pre-ex ordinary entitlements are receivables until first open after documented payable. Sales after completed published T+1 settlement. Amendment 21 requires complete inventory and primary advance notice; pre-action exit, flat through payable, cancel event with no late restart.
policy.controls: Training only: shift both open endpoints exactly seven calendar days earlier; both must be sessions, same interval count and wholly in partition. Exclude either BLS family and same FOMC windows; never roll/search. Diagnostics only.
policy.decision: Announced date D must be an equity session. Decide at close two sessions before D; enter preceding open; exit first open after D.
policy.exclusions: Exclude holding windows intersecting scheduled FOMC decision session or its preceding equity session, from advance Fed notices known by decision.
policy.fees_risk: EquityFeeBook 2026-09-17 current-account counterfactual; unchanged shared risk engine and PRD6.
policy.revisions: Only notices known before decision supersede/cancel. After decision preserve original exit. One entry per family/reference month; skip held overlaps. Missing/contradictory provenance fails.
policy.selection: Largest positive complete 10bp training net dollars, ordered ties; freeze before sole higher-cost final in canonical c12 family. Failed/interrupted final consumed.
policy.sizing: 140 virtual USD; min(95% decision equity, 140) frozen target; common 5% reserve and .01 fee reserve. Clip total exposure at rounded adverse limit to target, settled cash and slot; floor 1e-9 quantities; minimum $1.
